name: kintone
description: Business connector for kintone (Cybozu) through the kintone REST API, with one API token per app or an OAuth client. Read-only by default and limited to the apps and field codes an administrator lists; adding comments and creating records are separate opt-ins and always need a person's approval.

subdomain.description: kintone subdomain, e.g. example for https://example.cybozu.com.

auth.description: apiToken: one API token per app (kurahi kintone login asks for each). oauth: an OAuth client registered in cybozu.com common settings; its secret goes in the secret store (connector.kintone.clientSecret).

clientId.description: OAuth mode only: the OAuth client id.

redirectPort.description: OAuth mode only: fixed loopback port, matching the redirect endpoint registered for the client (http://localhost:<port>/callback).

apps.description: The apps the connector may read. Each needs its own API token (kurahi kintone login).

id.description: App id (the number in the app URL).

fields.description: Field codes the agent may read (and set, when createRecord is on). Nothing else is requested or returned.

comment.description: Allow adding record comments. Every comment needs a person's approval.

createRecord.description: Allow creating records (allowed fields only). Every record needs a person's approval.
